stories.headline: UBS lifts pre-tax profit 27% and raises its cost-saving goal to $13.7bn
stories.summary: UBS reported third-quarter net profit of $2.69bn, up 8%, and pre-tax profit of $3.59bn, up 27%. Wealth management drew $55.1bn of net new assets. Savings from the Credit Suisse integration reached $13.2bn, and UBS now expects about $13.7bn

stories.headline: Temenos raises its 2026 profit guidance after a strong third quarter
stories.summary: The Geneva banking software maker reported third-quarter revenue of $292.8m, up 13%, and non-IFRS EBIT of $109.3m, up 29%. Annual recurring revenue rose 12% in constant currency to $903.6m. Temenos now expects 2026 EBIT growth of about 12%

stories.headline: Microsoft offers voluntary departure to about 60,000 staff as AI spending grows
stories.summary: About 60,000 employees, roughly a quarter of Microsoft's workforce, can leave with a severance payment, according to an internal memo reported by Business Insider and covered by ICTjournal. Windows, Xbox, Copilot and finance teams are inclu

stories.headline: Deutsche Bank uses agentic AI to draft source-of-wealth assessments
stories.summary: Inside its KYC platform, the private bank's tool extracts and reconciles client information and drafts a memo that staff check and approve. It is live for some income-related checks in Singapore and Hong Kong and is being extended to Europe

stories.headline: LGT moves AI from pilots to client processes, starting with contact logs
stories.summary: An internally deployed tool now turns client conversations into draft contact logs that staff review and submit, said Simon Gomez, head of data and innovation at LGT Private Banking. The hardest part was getting colleagues to try it; demons

stories.headline: HSBC's third-quarter pre-tax profit rises 32% to $9.6bn
stories.summary: Revenue rose 5% to $18.6bn, driven by banking net interest income, and HSBC plans a share buyback of up to $1bn. Much of the profit rise reflects $1.4bn of legal provisions a year earlier that did not recur, the bank said.

stories.headline: Revolut will let retail clients invest in private tech companies from 2027
stories.summary: Revolut Ventures, run with Carne Group as a European long-term investment fund (ELTIF), will offer positions in unlisted companies through the app, according to Fintech News Switzerland, citing Bloomberg. BNY will be custodian.

stories.headline: Deutsche Börse opens DAX 40 shares to round-the-clock trading on 360X
stories.summary: Outside Xetra hours, DAX 40 stocks now trade overnight and at weekends on the 360X venue through requests for quotes, settling into existing Clearstream accounts, according to Fintech News Switzerland.

stories.headline: SAP lets its Joule agents run processes across SAP and other systems
stories.summary: At TechEd in Berlin, SAP made Joule Work generally available: users state a goal and agents coordinate the applications and data needed, including third-party systems, with role-based permissions, audit logs and human checkpoints. An Enterp

stories.headline: Salesforce adds a kill switch and hard spending limits for AI agents
stories.summary: Agent Fabric gains evaluations that test agents before and during production and can trigger a kill switch, plus a FinOps dashboard with spending limits that block requests before budgets are exceeded. The kill switch and cost controls are

stories.headline: Anthropic reports early results from six drug development partnerships using Claude
stories.summary: At Enveda, Claude reviewed 1,061 pages of manufacturing documents, found all 11 issues human reviewers had found plus seven more, and cut review time by 89%, Anthropic said. Partners include Bristol Myers Squibb and Generate Biomedicines; t

stories.headline: 1Password lets AI agents sign in to services without seeing passwords
stories.summary: With 1Password for Agents, an agent asks to log in, the user approves on their device, and 1Password fills in the credentials directly. It works with agents from Meta, Anthropic and OpenAI, according to Netzwoche.

stories.headline: Ermotti calls the Council of States' capital decision for UBS very concerning
stories.summary: On the results call on 28 October, UBS chief executive Sergio Ermotti said the latest proposal would tighten capital requirements already among the world's strictest and disregards most consultation responses, according to finews.com. He sa

stories.headline: BNY adds XRP and RLUSD custody and explores tokenised trade receivables with Ripple
stories.summary: BNY's Digital Asset Custody platform now supports XRP and Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin for eligible institutional clients, according to Fintech News Switzerland. With working capital platform C2FO, the two will explore supply chain finance usi

stories.headline: Wealthsimple raises up to CA$425 million at a CA$13.8 billion valuation
stories.summary: GIC leads the round, which includes a CA$300 million primary offering, according to Fintech News Switzerland. Assets under administration reached CA$169.2 billion at 30 September, and new chequing accounts outpaced new investment accounts f

stories.headline: Deutsche Bank posts a record third-quarter profit of 1.9 billion euros
stories.summary: Pre-tax profit rose 8 percent to 2.6 billion euros on revenue of 8.3 billion euros, the bank said. Assets under management reached 2.0 trillion euros with record third-quarter net inflows of 47 billion euros, and the cost/income ratio fell

stories.headline: BNP Paribas lifts quarterly profit 13.5 percent and plans a buyback
stories.summary: Net income attributable to the group reached 3,456 million euros on revenue of 13,757 million euros, up 9.5 percent, BNP Paribas said. The cost/income ratio fell 2.3 points to 58.3 percent, and the buyback launches in November.

stories.headline: European banks beat forecasts, but Brazil weighs on Santander
stories.summary: Santander's underlying net profit rose 19 percent, but weaker Brazilian earnings and higher provisions sent its shares down 4.2 percent, according to Reuters. Standard Chartered beat estimates and raised its income and profitability targets

stories.headline: Anthropic expands AI for Science to 20 foundations and research institutions
